patch_description: This replaces selected two-hop-path rewards with a neighborhood-diversity surrogate. Direct demand still favors useful links, while pairwise terms encourage each node’s two neighbors to have complementary traffic profiles and mildly penalize redundant, high-pressure neighborhoods. Reciprocal links receive a small bonus when traffic flows both ways. The pair terms form local groups around common sources or destinations, giving the partitioner a compact structure without explicitly ranking relays for each OD pair.
